story_sequence.text: Hook contracts live under `docs/beacon/hooks/<hook-id>.md`; version directories only hold research and requirement material.
Each hook is a single Markdown file with frontmatter and human-readable sections for purpose, admission, evidence, and failure route.
Hook admission validates lifecycle binding, enabled state, skill availability, command template, trigger policy, required evidence, and failure route; side-effect hooks require manual confirmation.
Hook runs write `.beacon/state/hooks/<hook-id>/<run-id>.json` and `docs/beacon/.machine/hooks/<hook-id>.latest.json` as evidence/read models only.
Operators can list, plan, dry-run, confirmed-run, disable, and inspect hook status without editing machine projections directly.
The contract covers Beacon post-release local install, Rolo post-implement UAT, and Rolo QA Debug Lab as fixtures, not global defaults.
Hooks cannot rewrite PRD, user-story, test-case, freeze state, QA verdict, release verdict, or gate verdict.
Hidden auto-run, arbitrary shell hooks, unknown hook codes, and missing failure routes fail closed with explicit reason codes.

decision_priority: Hook 是 project-level extension，不是 version-level feature artifact。
Hook 必须绑定有限 hook code，不允许任意时机隐式触发。
Hook 必须有 contract、admission、dry-run 和 evidence。
项目特有动作不得硬编码成 Beacon 全局默认。
涉及全局安装、UAT 发布、pipeline、写数据的 hook 必须 `manual_confirmed`。
Hook 输出只能作为 runtime / delivery / QA support evidence，不能改 requirement truth。
Hook failure 必须有 failure family 和 route，不得静默跳过。
`beacon.config.yaml` 不能成为 hook truth 的第二份副本。

inputs_contract: acceptance kit proof layers and gate context
decision_protocol: Continue in `qa` when implementation evidence exists and acceptance truth is frozen.
Route back to `implement` for execution gaps, to `change` for truth drift, or to `test-case` when coverage truth is insufficient.
Treat `skill-contract`, `scenario-suite`, `trace-scorecard`, and `real-project-proof` as layered verdicts, not one proxy score.
Verify route explainability, learning use visibility, and guardrail behavior when the feature claims a thicker human-facing decision surface.
anti_inertia_notes: `qa` is the only public verification entry, but it is not allowed to rewrite frozen truth silently.
Passing one layer does not imply release readiness.
Browser or live-environment blockers must be recorded explicitly, not masked as product failure.
`qa` cannot rewrite frozen truth or override gate truth by itself.
`beacon-qa-evo-deep` can produce routeable findings and release supplement input, but it cannot replace `beacon qa run` or produce QA/release verdicts.
learning_notes: Reuse prior QA findings as hint for scenario prioritization.
Learning can highlight likely failure modes, but it cannot convert blocked evidence into pass.
Stale learning should bias toward re-verification, not trust.
backstop_cli: `beacon qa evo-deep "<feature>" --project . --version <version>` for deep QA support findings
`beacon release ...` only after layered evidence is sufficient
